items.title: Energy Transfer vs. Occidental Petroleum: The Better Energy Buy for the Second Half of 2026
items.summary: The article compares two energy sector investments: Occidental Petroleum, an upstream oil and natural gas producer that benefits from rising commodity prices but carries volatility risk, and Energy Transfer, a midstream MLP that charges fees for moving energy and offers stable, high dividend yields. The choice depends on investor risk tolerance and price outlook for the second half of 2026.
